title: Don M NDEs 9676 NDE 9676
content: In 1989, I was driving a 1950 Chevy sedan. I was driving above 100 miles per hour on a Cuban country road. I tried to negotiate a narrow curve and failed as I came off the road, and hit several concrete fence poles and one big electrical pole. The car veered into the pasture that had some meadows. The car was flipping and rolling two or three times. At the second meadow, somehow or by someone, my body was extracted from the car. I was suspended in the air and landed softly on the ground. Although I only had a minimal scratch on my right hand only, the car broke apart in many pieces and was completely destroyed. During the experience, my future life as it happens afterward and it is now was flashed on my eyes and brain. I saw a bright light. I saw transparent entities protecting me who were covering my body like in a bubble. I also saw my future sons and daughter. On the ground, I could not believe I was undamaged. I was a newly graduated physician and I knew about physical lesions, etc. It was impossible to be in that accident and suffer no physical damage. I was able to walk away from the accident scene with my clothing that was almost clean. People who came to the scene were looking for a body inside the damaged car. Nobody could believe that I was the driver. When police arrived and confirmed it was my car and I was the driver, everybody present were in awe. From that day forward, I started believing in Angels. That is the only feasible explanation I can have of that event. In 2006, I developed cardiac arrhythmia and had a syncope after taking Metoprolol from low blood pressure and heart beat rate. I was taken to the hospital in Miami, Florida. I was working as a Registered Nurse at the time in the Cardiology unit. I was sedated, lying on the hospital stretcher as the doctor initiated a cardioversion procedure to stop my heart briefly and reinitiate it to break down the arrhythmic pattern. Somehow, it took longer that they expected to reinitiate my heart. I saw again a bright light, but this time it was preceded by a long, dark tunnel. In the light, I was greeted again by transparent entities, my deceased grandparents and my unborn daughter and son. I saw my body while my 'soul' was hovering over it. I saw the doctor and the team giving me CPR and preparing the AED although it was not used. Then I was pushed back to my body and my heart beat reestablished. Now, I have 3 sons and 1 daughter. My older son is 39 years old, he has 2 children. I have another son who is 25 years old, and my baby son is 8 months old. My daughter is 8 years old. I thank God every single day. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1989 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death. In 1989, a horrific automobile accident and in 2006 I had a surgery complication. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Saw people, things around me I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. All my senses were sharper than usual At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Always at the very end of the experience Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Described above Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I had premonitions of something impending every time of my experiences Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. My hearing was enhanced during the experience Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes Described above Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Described above Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Described above Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Described above What emotions did you feel during the experience? Awesome emotions Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others Described above Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future Described above Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic From that point in my life I started believing in Angels Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Described above What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I was raised Catholic, but at the time of my first experience I was not practicing it due to Political restrictions in Cuba. Physicians were prohibited to practice any religion, or attend church's by the communist's government at the time. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Described above Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Described above Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Uncertain Described above During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes Interesting detail. I found and has been present in my thoughts ever since that I had previous lives and will have future lives as well. It gives me sense of peace and confidence. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Described above During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes Described above Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes Described above During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes Described above During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain Described above Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes Overwhelming Love What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. Emigrated out of Cuba and Communisms, unexpectedly to the USA. Married and had 4 beautiful children and now two beautiful grandchildren. Went back to the university, got my Bachelors, Masters and Doctoral degrees in USA. Started and maintained several business creating jobs for many people. Able to care for my patient been more compassionate. Enjoy life much better. Understand the world even better. Have hope. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Described above After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes No matter how we write about t it, the wholeness of it is unique How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Those memories are so fixed in my memory, that I believe it will prevail even if I develop Alzheimer's in the future. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Better understanding of human beings and emotions Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Described above Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes In my inner family, other would not believe it. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real It was and still very vivid experience What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Described above At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Nope Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? None

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Long, dark tunnel (no movement sensation described).

arrival.other_being_detail: Transparent entities protecting him ("covering my body like in a bubble") and greeting him; also saw deceased grandparents and unborn daughter and son.

environment.environment_other_detail: Bright light; long dark tunnel preceding it (2006).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He was "pushed back to my body" and heartbeat reestablished.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two events described: (1) 1989 high-speed car accident; (2) 2006 cardioversion complication with delayed reinitiation of heartbeat/CPR.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Protective "bubble" of transparent entities during 1989 crash; future-life flashes (personal future scenes).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: 1989: protective entities/light and future flashes without tunnel described. 2006: tunnel → bright light → greeted by entities/relatives → OBE of resuscitation → pushed back into body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Bright light and transparent entities occurred in both 1989 and 2006 events.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: 1989: body "extracted from the car," suspended in the air, and landed softly; transparent entities "covering my body like in a bubble"; future children seen before they were born.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "transparent entities protecting me who were covering my body like in a bubble."
